description.en: Cataloguing where and why attention sinks form across model families, and what breaks when you remove them.
description.zh: 系统梳理不同模型家族中注意力汇聚点出现的位置与成因，以及移除它们之后会坏掉什么。

description.en: A harness for evaluating agents on tasks that take hundreds of steps, where per-step accuracy stops being a useful signal.
description.zh: 面向数百步长任务的智能体评测框架——在这种尺度上，逐步准确率已经不再是有意义的指标。

description.en: Exploring what is actually recoverable after aggressive KV cache eviction. Shelved pending better probes.
description.zh: 研究激进的 KV 缓存淘汰之后究竟还能恢复出什么。因缺乏更好的探针方法暂时搁置。
